title: Ɔyarefo no
intro: Bere tenten a atwam no, wɔ adesamma abakɔsɛm mfiase no, na akra abien gyina wɔn Bɔfo no anim de afɔrebɔde ma. Wogyee biako toom, na wɔannye biako. Nea edii akyi bae no bɛyɛ awerɛhosɛm kɛse a edi kan wɔ anuanom ntam - adeyɛ biako a ɛkyerɛ boasetɔ a wɔde hyɛ wɔn ho so ne adeyɛ biako a ɛkyerɛ aweredi a ɛyɛ yaw. So wubetumi ada onipa ko a meyɛ adi?
clues: Wɔwoo me wɔ nnipa asetra wɔ asase so nna a edi kan koraa mu
Ná meyɛ nnipa baanu a wodi kan koraa a wɔnantew asase yi so pɛn no ba
Bere bi mebɔɔ ​​afɔre bi fii me nguankuw no mufo a wɔyɛ papa mu de sɔɔ me Bɔfo no ani
Wogyee m’afɔrebɔ no fii soro, bere a wɔpoo me nua afɔrebɔde no
Bere a wɔde owu hunahunaa me no, mepaw sɛ meremma me nsa so nhyɛ me nua no so
Mebɛyɛɛ onipa a odi kan wɔ adesamma abakɔsɛm nyinaa mu a obi foforo kum me wɔ ɔkwan a ɛnteɛ so

trial.label: Sɔhwɛ/Asɛm a esii
options: Awudisɛm a edi kan wɔ adesamma abakɔsɛm mu
Ismail afɔrebɔ a Ibrahim de bɔɔ no
trial.answer: Awudisɛm a edi kan wɔ adesamma abakɔsɛm mu

location.label: Ade Titiriw
options: Oguan bi a wɔde bɔɔ afɔre a ɛsɔ ani
Anomaa bi a ɔyɛ hoopoe a okura adehye nkrasɛm
location.answer: Oguan bi a wɔde bɔɔ afɔre a ɛsɔ ani

outcome.label: Nsunsuansoɔ
options: Ɔbɛyɛɛ obi a odi kan a wokum no wɔ adesamma abakɔsɛm mu
Onyaa ne ti didii mu wɔ nsuyiri kɛse bi mu wɔ nnua anwenne bi mu
Ná ɔte apataa kɛse bi yafunu mu
Odii jinn, nnipa, ne mframa so
Ɔkyinkyin mfe aduanan wɔ sare kɛse bi so
outcome.answer: Ɔbɛyɛɛ obi a odi kan a wokum no wɔ adesamma abakɔsɛm mu

arabic: ۞ وَٱتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبَأَ ٱبْنَىْ ءَادَمَ بِٱلْحَقِّ إِذْ قَرَّبَا قُرْبَانًۭا فَتُقُبِّلَ مِنْ أَحَدِهِمَا وَلَمْ يُتَقَبَّلْ مِنَ ٱلْـَٔاخَرِ قَالَ لَأَقْتُلَنَّكَ ۖ قَالَ إِنَّمَا يَتَقَبَّلُ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
verse: And recite to them the story of Adam's two sons, in truth, when they both made an offering [to Allāh], and it was accepted from one of them but was not accepted from the other. Said [the latter], "I will surely kill you." Said [the former], "Indeed, Allāh only accepts from the righteous [who fear Him]. (5:27)
